performance_case.causal_mechanism: An exact dual-release and active-source read-only verification entrypoint can detect liveness, isolation or release drift before a lost forward day without adding a timer, writer or inferred trust decision.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This slice proves only a noninteractive wrapper contract, focused static tests and later one Manager-run read-only server verification. It cannot prove source continuity through day close, predictive value, fees, slippage, PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading value.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero because no strategy or runtime state changes. Any later path-risk benefit remains contingent on prospective evidence and a separately preregistered matched-capital experiment.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: Without a valid standalone active-source verifier, an operator may discover a dead or drifted forward source only after the next canonical deadline, losing an untouched day and delaying the first credible accept-or-reject strategy decision.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Immediate fee-adjusted total PnL is unchanged; the infrastructure value is reducing avoidable evidence latency and false verification failures so the bounded Local diagnostic can reach a trustworthy strategy mechanism decision sooner.
